What is the LED MoonBoard ?

The MoonBoard LED system brings easy identification of problems to the MoonBoard. Beneath each MoonBoard t-nut position is an LED light, which is controlled by our MoonBoard App via bluetooth. When the user selects a problem on the App, the holds that make up that problem are illuminated by their corresponding LED lights.


Our new LED system gives users access to tens of thousands of MoonBoard problems in just a click and a swipe, making the MoonBoard training facility even more user-friendly and accessible than ever before. Multiple climbers can pair and control the LED system at the same time. The new V2 LED control box can illuminate the LEDs above and below the holds making it easier to locate the next hand or foot hold during climbing.
